definitions.explanation: Sweat caused by fear, nervousness, or a close call rather than heat or exertion.

examples.english: I broke into a cold sweat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Listening to his speech made me break out in a cold sweat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧そば⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}り{過|す}ぎて→通り過ぎる：02372_toorisugiru⟧、{冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: A car passed right by me and I couldn't stop the cold sweat.

notes:
{冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ} is a cold sweat caused by fear, anxiety, or a close call — never by physical heat or exertion. Unlike ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧ alone, it always implies a psychological trigger.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かく: to break into a cold sweat
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: cold sweat comes out
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: can't stop the cold sweat

TYPICAL SITUATIONS:
- Narrowly avoiding danger (⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧)
- Watching someone make a risky mistake
- Feeling nervous during a presentation or test
- Realizing a serious error

ETYMOLOGY:
Combines {冷|ひ}やっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to feel a chill) with ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧ (sweat).
